fields.device_model: Redmi K Pad (红米 K Pad)
fields.graphics_driver: System (Mali Vulkan)  AND  Wrapper-leegao  -> both corrupted
fields.repro:
1. Bannerlator 3.1.6, container-1: Display backend X11, Graphics driver System, Proton-10.0-4-arm64ec, 1280x800
2. Environment: GALLIUM_DRIVER=zink, MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE=4.5 (without the override the game only reaches 164 MB and hangs: Mali Vulkan lacks fillModeNonSolid/shaderClipDistance so Zink reports a GL version below the game's required 4.4)
3. Games -> Mewgenics card -> LAUNCH WITH -> Raw .exe -> Launch
4. After 1-3 min free RAM drops 4.5 GB -> 1.8-2.2 GB (the game IS loaded) but the image is corrupted from the very first frame: large diagonal slabs, smooth green/white/tan gradients with hard diagonal edges and big black triangles - looks like a framebuffer stride/tiling mismatch.
5. Wine's 2D/GDI stays perfectly sharp (e.g. the Fatal Error dialog) - ONLY the GL surface is corrupted.
fields.tried:
Renderer: Zink (Mali Vulkan) AND softpipe (pure CPU rasterizer) -> SAME corruption, identical shape => rules out the renderer/driver.
Graphics driver: System AND Wrapper-leegao -> same.
Fast OpenGL: on AND off (OpenGL card -> Fast -> Off) -> same.
Display backend: X11 corrupted; Wayland fails earlier: 'Could not create window: No matching GL pixel format available' (Error 65542), compositor log shows 0 GPU frames from games.
Post-processing: Scaling=None, Sharpen(CAS)/HDR/Debanding off -> same. Fullscreen Mode Off/Fit -> same.
Also injected a self cross-compiled Mesa (libgallium-26.3.0-devel.so, -Dplatforms=x11,wayland -Dglx=dri -Dgallium-drivers=zink,virgl,softpipe, plus libwayland-client.so.0 soname aliases and libexpat/libsync/libc++_shared) via repacked .wcp -> injection itself works (app shows Installed, container loads it), corruption unchanged.
Cross-check with a different app: Winlator 11.1 + Vortek + WineD3D -> black screen and the game never loads (only ~1.4 GB used), whereas Bannerlator+Zink does load it (2.3-2.7 GB) but renders corrupted.

Bannerlator's own compositor log (/sdcard/Download/Wayland-logs/):
gpu    compositor renders on Mali-G925-Immortalis MC12 with the system Vulkan driver
dmabuf formats: AR24 linear, XR24 linear, AB24 linear, XB24 linear
dmabuf the compositor's driver (Mali-G925-Immortalis MC12) reports no importable qcom_compressed layout: game swapchains stay linear
stats  last 10 s: 21 frames on screen (2.1 fps) | 0 GPU frames from games

Hypothesis: on this Mali device the hand-off between the GL surface and the Vulkan swapchain / linear buffer (cf. leegao 'WSI Woes on Mali') mishandles stride/tiling. Note Mali has no Turnip (Adreno-only; PanVK does not support CSF/Immortalis) while the Fast OpenGL GLX route is documented as needing Turnip.
